name: Toki no Mori no Monogatari ~Tear~
source:
Warran Kingdom in the northern part of the Vorobian Continent. Main character Rex holds accepts various requests for the living. a  is a store anything that deals with various duties. His childhood acquaintance is the princess of the kingdom, and she recommends Rex for a task to find the source of demons. Will Rex be able to protect those he loves from demons and conspiracies?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
沃罗比安大陆北部的沃兰王国。主人公雷克斯经营着一家承接各种委托的万事屋。他的青梅竹马是王国的公主，她推荐雷克斯接下寻找恶魔源头的任务。雷克斯能否保护他所爱的人免受恶魔和阴谋的侵害？
